Chat request with custom stop sequences that terminates generation at a stop token

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "List items until you see STOP" } } as Message], model: "gpt-4", stop: ["STOP", "END"] });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
}

void main();
```
